REQUEST_ERROR with UNAUTHORIZED (0x1), retry immediately
REQUEST_ERROR with DOES_NOT_EXIST (0x10), not retryable
REQUEST_ERROR with empty reason phrase, not retryable
REQUEST_ERROR with TIMEOUT (0x2), not retryable
REQUEST_ERROR with NOT_SUPPORTED (0x3), not retryable

REQUEST_ERROR with EXPIRED_AUTH_TOKEN (0x5), not retryable
REQUEST_ERROR with GOING_AWAY (0x6), not retryable
REQUEST_ERROR with EXCESSIVE_LOAD (0x9), not retryable

REQUEST_ERROR with UNAVAILABLE (0xA), new in draft-23, retry after 1000 ms (Retry Interval 1001, the two-byte vi64 83e9) and an empty reason. Section 7.4: "A relay that lacks stream credit to forward a request can fail it immediately with UNAVAILABLE, or wait for credit and fail it with TIMEOUT if none arrives."
REQUEST_ERROR with INVALID_RANGE (0x11), not retryable
REQUEST_ERROR with MALFORMED_TRACK (0x12), not retryable
REQUEST_ERROR with UNINTERESTED (0x20), not retryable

REQUEST_ERROR carrying error code 0x30. Draft-22 named it PREFIX_OVERLAP; draft-23 removed it and Table 21 has no row for it, so it is an unknown code. Section 13: "Receipt of an unknown error code in any error context (Session Termination, REQUEST_ERROR, PUBLISH_DONE, or Data Stream Reset) MUST be treated as equivalent to INTERNAL_ERROR for that context. An endpoint MUST NOT close the session because it received an unknown error code in a REQUEST_ERROR or PUBLISH_DONE." The frame decodes
REQUEST_ERROR with NAMESPACE_TOO_LARGE (0x31), not retryable
REQUEST_ERROR with UNSUPPORTED_EXTENSION (0x33) and no Error Details

REQUEST_ERROR with UNSUPPORTED_EXTENSION (0x33) naming Mandatory Track Properties 0x4000 and 0x4002 in two UNSUPPORTED_PROPERTY Error Details (Type 0x02, even, so a bare vi64). The second is a Delta Type of 0. Section 9.4.2.2: "Multiple instances of this type are allowed."

REQUEST_ERROR with DOES_NOT_EXIST (0x10) carrying an UNSUPPORTED_PROPERTY Error Detail. The frame decodes. Section 9.4.2: receivers "MUST ignore a known Error Detail type that accompanies an Error Code it is not defined for."
REQUEST_ERROR with CONFLICTING_FILTERS (0x35)
REQUEST_ERROR with INVALID_FILTER (0x36); a Range Filter parameter is invalid or exceeds MAX_FILTER_RANGES

REQUEST_ERROR carrying error code 0x32, which draft-23 leaves unassigned. Section 13: "Receipt of an unknown error code in any error context (Session Termination, REQUEST_ERROR, PUBLISH_DONE, or Data Stream Reset) MUST be treated as equivalent to INTERNAL_ERROR for that context. An endpoint MUST NOT close the session because it received an unknown error code in a REQUEST_ERROR or PUBLISH_DONE." The frame decodes
REQUEST_ERROR with INTERNAL_ERROR and a 200-byte reason phrase, so the body is 204 bytes and the Message Length is the two-byte vi64 80cc. A 16-bit Length would be 00 cc

vectors.description: REQUEST_ERROR with REDIRECT (0x34) and a REDIRECT Error Detail (Type 0x01, odd, so Length-prefixed) pointing at moqt://relay.example.com/path and a new full track name. Draft-22 carried the Redirect structure bare after the reason phrase
REQUEST_ERROR with REDIRECT (0x34) and a REDIRECT Error Detail with a zero-length Connect URI (reuse current session) and a renamed track
REQUEST_ERROR with REDIRECT, Retry Interval 0, an empty reason and a REDIRECT Error Detail with an empty Connect URI, namespace ('a') and Track Name 'b': 05 0b 34 00 00 01 06 00 01 01 61 01 62

REQUEST_ERROR with REDIRECT (0x34) for a namespace-scoped request: empty Track Name. Section 9.4.2.1: "Track Name is not meaningful for namespace-scoped requests (SUBSCRIBE_NAMESPACE, PUBLISH_NAMESPACE, SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS) and MUST be empty"

REQUEST_ERROR with REDIRECT (0x34) whose REDIRECT Error Detail has a zero-field Track Namespace and an empty Track Name. Section 9.4.2.1 calls the pair the Redirect target; these are literal empty values

REQUEST_ERROR with REDIRECT whose REDIRECT Error Detail is followed by Error Detail Type 0x9D, a grease value (Section 13), with an empty value: Delta Type 0x9C (the two-byte vi64 809c) and, 0x9D being odd, Length 0. Section 9.4.2: "Receivers MUST ignore unknown Error Detail types". The entry is kept, without a name

REQUEST_ERROR with INTERNAL_ERROR, an empty reason and Error Detail Type 0x11C, the second grease value of Section 13 (0x7f * N + 0x9D). 0x11C is even, so its value is a bare vi64, 5, after the Delta Type 811c. Section 9.4.2: "Receivers MUST ignore unknown Error Detail types". The entry is kept, without a name

REQUEST_ERROR with REDIRECT whose REDIRECT Error Detail has Length 7: the 6-byte structure of redirect-short (empty Connect URI, namespace ('a'), Track Name 'b'), then one more byte, 00. Section 8.3: "If a receiver understands a Type, and the following Value or Length/Value does not match the serialization defined by that Type, the receiver MUST close the session with MALFORMED_KEY_VALUE."
vectors.error_detail: one byte follows the REDIRECT structure inside its Length

vectors.description: REQUEST_ERROR with REDIRECT (0x34) and no Error Details. Section 9.4.2.1: "An endpoint that receives a REQUEST_ERROR with Error Code REDIRECT and no REDIRECT Error Detail MUST close the session with MALFORMED_MESSAGE."
vectors.error_detail: Error Code REDIRECT requires a REDIRECT Error Detail

vectors.description: REQUEST_ERROR with REDIRECT carrying draft-22's bare Redirect structure (empty URI, namespace ('a'), name 'b') after the reason phrase, under a vi64 Length. Read as Error Details, 00 01 is Type 0 with value 1, then 01 61 is Type 1, REDIRECT, with a Length of 97 that runs past the message
vectors.error_detail: the REDIRECT Error Detail Length runs past the message
